# PrayCalc Final Deep-QA Pass — 2026-07-06

> Full A-Z pass across web, desktop, and mobile before calling the surface set
> production-ready. Six QA dimensions, each run as its own check: web-live,
> web-gauntlet, mobile, desktop, integration, repo-hygiene. Every blocker below
> was verified live against production, not just read from source.

## Scope

- **web-live** — praycalc.com routes and API endpoints hit directly in production.
- **web-gauntlet** — full E2E/unit suite plus a manual pass over recent P1 fixes
  (embed, preferences, city pages).
- **mobile** — React Native + Expo app, focused on the areas touched by the prior
  competitive audit session.
- **desktop** — Tauri 2 menu bar / tray app on macOS, Windows, Linux.
- **integration** — cross-surface auth and billing calls against the real
  `auth.ummat.dev` and `smart.praycalc.com` services (not mocks).
- **repo-hygiene** — stale branches, worktrees, and stashes left behind by prior
  sessions.

---

## Blockers found (root cause + fix)

### 1. Auth: every client called a 502 path

All three clients — web, desktop, mobile — called
`auth.ummat.dev/v1/auth/*`. Nginx has no upstream for that prefix, so every
call 502'd. Production sign-in, sign-up, and token refresh had never worked
outside local mocks.

The live service is hasura-auth 0.36, and it only serves bare paths:
`/signin/email-password`, `/signup/email-password`, `/token`, `/signout`,
`/signin/passwordless/email`. Verified live: `/v1/auth/*` returns 502;
the bare paths return 400 on an empty body, which means they're alive and
validating input.

**Fix:** switched every client to the bare paths and corrected a misleading
in-repo comment that said auth calls "MUST use /v1/auth". Touched:
`desktop/src/lib/auth-types.ts`, `desktop/src/lib/auth.ts`,
`mobile/src/lib/auth/authClient.ts` (+ its test), `web/__tests__/unit/auth-client.test.ts`.
Commit `2534729`. Web itself already used the httpOnly-cookie proxy
architecture from PR #67 (`/api/auth/*` routes + `src/lib/auth/hasura.server.ts`),
so the web fix was mostly the test file; desktop and mobile needed real
client-code changes.

### 2. Billing: wrong host entirely

Defaults pointed at `api.praycalc.com/billing`. That host is the Hasura CORS
endpoint for GraphQL — it 404s on `/billing`, it was never going to serve
billing. The real billing service (`smart/src/routes/billing.ts`, routes
`/status`, `/checkout`) lives at `smart.praycalc.com`. Verified live:
`smart.praycalc.com/billing/status` returns 401 (requireAuth alive, wrong
host would 404).

With the old default, Ummat+ entitlement checks silently returned
`isPlus: false` for every real subscriber — a silent downgrade, not a loud
failure.

**Fix:** corrected the default in `web/src/pages/api/billing/checkout.ts` and
`web/src/pages/api/billing/status.ts` (web proxies to the smart service, per
PR #67 architecture). Desktop calls `smart.praycalc.com` directly, so its
Tauri CSP `connect-src` needed the host added
(`desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json`). Commit `6c9c991`.

### 3. Embed: iframe blocked site-wide

`/embed` could not be iframed anywhere. The blanket header rule in
`web/vercel.json` sets `X-Frame-Options: DENY` and
`Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'none'` on every route. The entire
embeddable-widget feature was dead on arrival for any real embedder.

Vercel headers cannot be unset by a later matching rule — only overridden.
So the fix is a route-scoped override on `/embed`: CSP `frame-ancestors *`
(governs the actual framing decision in modern browsers) plus
`X-Frame-Options: ALLOWALL` — not a real XFO value, so browsers that still
honor XFO ignore it instead of falling back to DENY. See the `/embed` block
in `web/vercel.json`.

Commit `62f2e8f`.

## Minor fixes

### 4. tz validation on `/api/prayers` and `/api/calendar.ics`

`getUtcOffset()` (`web/src/lib/geo.ts`) accepts an IANA zone name
(`America/New_York`) or a numeric UTC offset (`-14`..`14`) for backward
compatibility. Before this pass, an invalid value threw an unhandled Luxon
`RangeError` that surfaced to the caller as a masked 500. Both API routes now
catch the error and return a clean `400` with a message naming the bad value.
Verified live: `tz=3` returns 200, `tz=bogus` returns 400.

Commit `62f2e8f` (same commit as the embed fix — both were part of the same
web deep-QA sweep).

### 5. Mobile fixes

- **Travel-aware Qibla.** `QiblaScreen` read the home location directly,
  ignoring travel/musafir mode. Every other prayer surface in the app already
  used `useActiveLocation()`; Qibla was the one screen that hadn't been
  updated. Now consistent.
- **Real offline detection.** The "offline" UI state existed but
  `setIsOffline` was never called — dead code. Wired to `expo-network`
  (initial state + a live listener) so the app actually shows last-known
  prayer times when connectivity drops, instead of silently pretending to be
  online.
- **mobile/docs/PARITY-GATE.md correction.** Row 5 claimed the Tehran calculation method
  was implemented. It isn't — it's intentionally excluded per D-P3-19 (not in
  `pray-calc`'s Methods map). Corrected the doc to say so.

Commit `e13cc3d`.

### 6. Changelog

`.github/wiki/Changelog.md` updated with a 2026-07-06 entry summarizing this
pass. Commit `a4d4ee3`.

## Verification evidence

### CI matrix

All CI green as of `e13cc3d`, including the 3-OS Tauri desktop build
(macOS, Windows, Ubuntu). The Ubuntu leg needed one re-run — it hit a
transient HTTP 429 while downloading AppImage packaging tooling, not a real
failure. Re-run passed clean.

### Live probes (production)

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `auth.ummat.dev/v1/auth/signin/email-password` | 502 (confirms the old prefix is dead — never fix this the wrong way by adding an upstream for it) |
| `auth.ummat.dev/signin/email-password` (empty body) | 400 (alive, validating) |
| `smart.praycalc.com/billing/status` (no token) | 401 (alive, requireAuth working) |
| `api.praycalc.com/billing` | 404 (confirms this host was never the right one) |
| `praycalc.com/embed` in an iframe | Renders — frameable again |
| `praycalc.com/api/prayers?...&tz=3` | 200 |
| `praycalc.com/api/prayers?...&tz=bogus` | 400 |
| `praycalc.com/preferences` | Single footer landmark, no California link, unsubscribe works |
| `praycalc.com/mecca` | SSR `<h1>` present in raw HTML (crawler/screen-reader visible) |
